label: House of Lords crisis and parliamentary unrest in Britain, 1909-1911

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael says the December 29, 1909 Saturn-Mars conjunction in Aries, ruling England, brought serious troubles during its rule to August 16, 1911, and that serious difficulties arose in Parliament in connection with the House of Lords.

notes: Benchmark for parliamentary and constitutional unrest rather than street violence only.

label: United Kingdom General Strike of 1926

source_assertions.title: Mundane Astrology: The Astrology of Nations and States
source_assertions.claim: Carter says that in the London map for the Leo conjunction the ascendant came to the opposition of Uranus in 1926, marked by the General Strike.

notes: Benchmark for mass labor unrest from a conjunction-cycle direction rather than a single ingress figure.

label: Swadeshi agitation and boycott unrest in British India, 1905-1908

source_assertions.title: The Annotated Raphael's Mundane Astrology
source_assertions.claim: Raphael says Uranus passing through the sign ruling a country causes insurrections, strikes, and rioting among the people and cites events then occurring in India while Uranus passed through Capricorn, the sign ruling India.

source_assertions.title: Britannica on the Swadeshi Movement
source_assertions.claim: Britannica says the Swadeshi Movement was formally launched in August 1905 after the partition of Bengal and spread through protest, boycott, volunteer organization, and anti-colonial agitation before declining by 1908.

notes: Post-Phase-5 hardening case: first non-British public-agitation benchmark for civil unrest.
